translationRepairs: Yewang set his inspector on Bing; Zhao Du of Shuyi proved ten jin of embezzled gold and moved to arrest him.
Yewang directed his regional inspector clerk Zhao Du of Duiyu to investigate; he proved Bing's crime of embezzling ten jin of gold while in office, and arrested him.

Chapter 示殳祤 looks like a corrupt split of 祋 (示+殳) before 祤; Wikisource and CText read 祋祤趙都—one duyuan clerk, Zhao Du of Duiyu county—not two men. The proposal invents Shi Shutao; the original rightly keeps a single agent but misromanizes the county as Shuyi.
